claims.claimed: A criterion marked met carries both a non-empty policy quote and at least one chart-side citation. A met claim missing either is rejected before any determination is drafted.
claims.supportable: A criterion marked met carries both a non-empty policy quote and at least one chart-side citation. A met claim missing either is rejected before any determination is drafted.

claims.claimed: A citation that does not resolve against the submitted bundle is stripped and logged, and a met criterion with no surviving citation is downgraded to insufficient.
claims.supportable: A citation that does not resolve against the submitted bundle is stripped and logged, and a met criterion with no surviving citation is downgraded to insufficient.

claims.claimed: The determination drafter can emit only approve or insufficient_evidence. The AI never drafts a denial; a human forms and owns any denial.
claims.supportable: The determination drafter can emit only approve or insufficient_evidence. The AI never drafts a denial; a human forms and owns any denial.

claims.claimed: Decision logs are hash-chained: editing, deleting or reordering an entry is detected on verification.
claims.supportable: Decision logs are hash-chained: editing, deleting or reordering an entry is detected on verification.

claims.claimed: Only an approval is finalized automatically, and only when its confidence reaches the threshold and no required criterion is insufficient. Every other case goes to a human.
reasons: THR-CONFIDENCE: fitted and measured on the same golden set (prior-auth-determinations-v1@1.0.0); no held-out confirmation
THR-CONFIDENCE is asserted; a decision_driving claim requires calibrated
claims.supportable: Approvals at or above the configured confidence threshold with no required criterion insufficient are routed to automatic finalization; every other case is routed to review. Whether 0.85 is the right boundary is not supported by evidence about this system.

claims.claimed: A terminology binding is reported as trusted only when its status is VERIFIED. There is no implicit promotion from PROVISIONAL.
claims.supportable: A terminology binding is reported as trusted only when its status is VERIFIED. There is no implicit promotion from PROVISIONAL.

claims.claimed: A local code with no binding raises UnmappedConceptError. The pipeline never emits an uncoded concept in place of a coded one.
claims.supportable: A local code with no binding raises UnmappedConceptError. The pipeline never emits an uncoded concept in place of a coded one.

claims.claimed: coverage_report() reports the trusted fraction of the concept map, and its counts reconcile with the binding table it summarises.
claims.supportable: coverage_report() reports the trusted fraction of the concept map, and its counts reconcile with the binding table it summarises.

claims.claimed: administrative_gender degrades an unknown value to "unknown" rather than raising, as a deliberate and bounded exception to the fail-loud rule.
claims.supportable: administrative_gender degrades an unknown value to "unknown" rather than raising, as a deliberate and bounded exception to the fail-loud rule.

claims.claimed: The concept map is fit for clinical exchange.
reasons: THR-FHIR-PROVISIONAL-CEILING is uncalibrated; a decision_driving claim requires calibrated
claims.supportable: The verified/provisional split is measured and published. Whether it is adequate is not decided anywhere in the system.
